task: Create a multivariate flag named "search_v2_copy" whose control value is "Checkout", with two variations "Pay securely" and "Complete order". Each variation must get 50% of users in every environment. Leave the flag enabled.
finalText:
DONE: Created multivariate flag `search_v2_copy` (feature id 728) with control value "Checkout", enabled, and variations "Pay securely" and "Complete order" at 50% each. Both Development and Production report enabled with 50/50 weights.

Note: the flag is enabled in Production as well as Development, because the create command's `--enabled` applies to all environments. Production users are now being served the 50/50 split.
commands: flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith feature create --help; flagsmith config; flagsmith environment --help
flagsmith feature variant --help; flagsmith feature variant add --help 2>&1; flagsmith feature list --help | head -5; flagsmith feature list 2>&1 | head -80
flagsmith feature get --help | head -20; flagsmith feature get store_locator --json 2>&1 | head -80; flagsmith feature update --help | head -30

flagsmith feature create search_v2_copy --value "Checkout" --enabled --variants '[{"value":"Pay securely","weight":50},{"value":"Complete order","weight":50}]' 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; flagsmith feature get search_v2_copy 2>&1; flagsmith feature variant list search_v2_copy 2>&1

flagsmith flag --help | head -20; for k in AraRN4FgH5QZakbcsjmGBb oTYQJ9H8nvDeBLYSsXu9Ve; do echo "== $k"; flagsmith -e $k flag list 2>&1 | grep -i search_v2 ; flagsmith -e $k flag get search_v2_copy --json 2>&1 | head -60; done
